name: 80917 · Colorado Spgs, CO
findings: ZIP 80917 (Colorado Spgs) has 83 nonprofit organizations. 33 of them (40%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 29 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (36% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 80917 (Colorado Spgs) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 80917 (Colorado Spgs) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 60% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 28 organizations here; 34% of all organizations here have no identified type.
